alt: Crowd of World Cup fans in USA jerseys queuing at a large blue FIFA 'Gate C / Workforce & Volunteer Entrance' sign at Los Angeles Stadium
story: FIFA's Los Angeles Stadium opened Gate C with no public-facing signage, sending thousands of ticketed fans into a queue at a 'Workforce & Volunteer Entrance' that turned them away — then forced a half-mile walk around the stadium to find the actual public gate.
why_funny: The gate that thousands lined up for was, specifically, the one not for them — announced on a sign they apparently did not read until they were already in the queue.
